import copy
import unittest

from solution import expand_device_profiles


class ExpandDeviceProfilesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_products_global_columns_and_order(self):
        profiles = [
            {"kind": "phone", "color": ["black", "white"], "memory": [64, 128]},
            {"kind": "watch", "band": ["small"]},
            {"kind": "plain"},
        ]
        result = expand_device_profiles(profiles)
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {"device_kind": "phone", "band": None, "color": "black", "memory": 64},
            {"device_kind": "phone", "band": None, "color": "black", "memory": 128},
            {"device_kind": "phone", "band": None, "color": "white", "memory": 64},
            {"device_kind": "phone", "band": None, "color": "white", "memory": 128},
            {"device_kind": "watch", "band": "small", "color": None, "memory": None},
            {"device_kind": "plain", "band": None, "color": None, "memory": None},
        ])
        for row in result:
            self.assertEqual(list(row), ["device_kind", "band", "color", "memory"])

    def test_empty_option_list_suppresses_only_its_profile(self):
        profiles = [
            {"kind": "none", "z": []},
            {"kind": "other", "a": [1]},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            expand_device_profiles(profiles),
            [{"device_kind": "other", "a": 1, "z": None}],
        )
        self.assertEqual(expand_device_profiles([]), [])

    def test_selected_values_are_deep_copied_per_row(self):
        shared = {"nested": [1]}
        profiles = [{"kind": "k", "option": [shared, shared]}]
        before = copy.deepcopy(profiles)
        result = expand_device_profiles(profiles)
        self.assertEqual(profiles, before)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["option"], shared)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["option"], result[1]["option"])
        result[0]["option"]["nested"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["option"], {"nested": [1]})
        self.assertEqual(shared, {"nested": [1]})
        shared["nested"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["option"], {"nested": [1]})

    def test_malformed_inputs(self):
        bad_inputs = [
            None,
            {},
            [None],
            [{}],
            [{"kind": ""}],
            [{"kind": 3}],
            [{"kind": "x", "": [1]}],
            [{"kind": "x", 4: [1]}],
            [{"kind": "x", "option": (1, 2)}],
            [{"kind": "x", "option": None}],
        ]
        for profiles in bad_inputs:
            with self.subTest(profiles=profiles):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    expand_device_profiles(profiles)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
